curation.lead:
Lesley Groff was the central operational coordinator for Jeffrey Epstein’s daily affairs, employed formally through Darren Indyke’s firm DKIP LLC (lgroff@dkipllc.com) while listing New York Strategy Group as her employer on federal filings [FEC:C00528182]. Corpus records show her name in 564 documents alongside Epstein — more than any other individual except his pilots and Deutsche Bank relationship managers — a frequency that, on the available record, makes her one of the most documented conduits between Epstein and the outside world [Finding #342]. Meeting requests, flight bookings, wire instructions, apartment assignments, and gift deliveries in the documentary record routinely passed through Groff.

What distinguishes Groff from a typical executive assistant is the breadth of fiduciary roles she accumulated. She served as co-trustee of The 2017 Caterpillar Trust at Deutsche Bank [EFTA01364043][EFTA02282632], signatory for Enhanced Education (the disbursement vehicle through which Leon Black’s millions flowed) [EFTA02671219], and had signing authority for Gratitude America Ltd. She held personal loans from Southern Financial LLC — an Epstein-controlled entity — creating a financial dependency that bound her to the network beyond mere employment [EFTA02270094]. Her FEC donations mirrored those of Indyke, with both contributing to the same U.S. Virgin Islands delegate and listing NYSG as their employer [FEC:C00528182][Finding #450].

Groff operated from New Canaan, Connecticut, but her documented activities spanned New York, Paris, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Morocco, and Mongolia. She managed relationships with figures ranging from Lawrence Summers and General Wesley Clark to Eva Dubin and Vincenzo Iozzo, coordinated travel for young women to Epstein’s Paris apartments, and assigned living quarters (“2G is clean and ready for next guest”) [EFTA02428343]. She remained operational through the final months before Epstein’s July 2019 arrest, booking the entourage’s April 2019 flight to Paris that included Indyke, Richard Kahn, and household staff [EFTA02279594].
curation.system_role: Groff served as a central operational coordinator within the Epstein network, translating Epstein's directives into executed logistics while accumulating fiduciary positions across his trust and foundation structure that made her simultaneously employee, trustee, signatory, and debtor. The documentary record indicates this layering of roles aligned her interests with the network through financial obligation rather than through any explicit co-conspiracy.

sections.title: The Operational Command Center
sections.content:
A review of the documents indicates that Groff functioned as a primary channel through which the enterprise's day-to-day communications flowed [Finding #342]. Those same records show her name in 564 documents alongside Epstein, more than that of Darren Indyke (with whom she co-appears in 42 documents), and on a par with pilot Paul Morris (391) and Deutsche Bank relationship manager Amanda Kirby (83), placing her among the most frequently documented operational figures in the record [Finding #342].

Her daily responsibilities encompassed every dimension of Epstein’s life. She tracked private aircraft N120JE via FlightAware alerts [EFTA02232360], booked commercial flights through AmEx Travel, arranged hotel stays at La Mamounia in Marrakech and the Mandarin in various cities [EFTA02270644], and coordinated Eurostar pickups in Paris. She managed household staff across properties, directed Amazon deliveries to Red Hook in the U.S. Virgin Islands, and assigned apartments to guests — the phrase “2G is clean and ready for next guest” appearing in her communications [EFTA02428343]. When Lawrence Summers’s office called in January 2014 to arrange a meeting between Epstein and the President of Mongolia, it was Groff who received the message and checked visa requirements [EFTA02519011][EFTA02714345].

The scheduling function gave Groff unique visibility into the full scope of Epstein’s contacts. She coordinated meetings with Leon Botstein (President of Bard College, September 2017) [EFTA02221547], General Wesley Clark (March 2010, with instructions to “make sure he is bringing Meghan”) [EFTA02428343], Martin Nowak at Harvard (July 2009), and Robert Lawrence Kuhn (15+ meetings at 9 East 71st Street from October 2016 through June 2019) [EFTA02271407][EFTA02285506]. She served as the primary point of contact for Vincenzo Iozzo from 2015 to 2018, scheduling meetings in both New York and Paris with a warm familiarity (“Vincenzo, you are so good with your calendar!”) [EFTA00333383][EFTA02214916] before that function shifted to Bebe Avdiu at Indyke PLLC in mid-2017.

sections.title: Fiduciary Entanglement: Trustee, Signatory, Debtor
sections.content:
Groff’s role extended beyond operations into the formal legal architecture of Epstein’s financial network. She served as co-trustee of The 2017 Caterpillar Trust from its formation on January 3, 2017, alongside Daphne Wallace, Epstein’s USVI office manager [EFTA01364043]. Both trustees were required to co-sign authorization letters for Deutsche Bank to process trust checks [EFTA02282632]. During the trust’s wind-down in April 2019 — just months before Epstein’s arrest — Groff joked about “keeping the check,” a remark documented in the trust correspondence [EFTA02282564].

She also served as signatory for Enhanced Education, the trade name of J. Epstein Virgin Islands Foundation — the entity through which Leon Black channeled a $158.5 million pledge and which disbursed grants to institutions including the International Peace Institute. In November 2015, Groff signed a conference room contract at the Fairmont Waterfront Vancouver on Enhanced Education’s behalf, using her personal email lesleyjee@gmail.com [EFTA02671219]. For Gratitude America Ltd, she used the foundation’s stationery for a school recommendation letter at Epstein’s direction, with Richard Kahn instructing her to use “no logo, use 6100 Red Hook address” — a detail that reveals deliberate management of how Epstein’s charitable entities presented themselves externally.

Groff held personal loans from Southern Financial LLC, the core Epstein-controlled financial entity. In one email to Kahn, she asked: “Can you confirm I am to pay all 3 of my loans to Southern Financial LLC — it is never to Southern Trust” [EFTA02270094]. In another, she noted she needed to “re-write check to Southern Financial LLC and give to Rich” [EFTA02234489]. The existence of multiple personal loans from an entity controlled by her employer created a financial dependency that transcended normal employment — a structure that ensured loyalty through obligation rather than compensation alone.

sections.title: Coordinated Political Giving
sections.content:
FEC records reveal a pattern of coordinated political donations from the Epstein inner circle [Finding #450]. Groff made two recorded contributions, both listing her employer as New York Strategy Group and her occupation as “Personal Assistant,” filed from New Canaan, Connecticut [FEC:C00431379][FEC:C00528182]. The first, $2,300 to Chris Dodd for President on June 30, 2007, paralleled a separate $4,400 contribution from Kenneth Starr (Epstein’s financial manager, later convicted of fraud) to Friends of Chris Dodd in 2009 [FEC:C00347310]. The second and more significant contribution was $2,600 to Virgin Islanders for Plaskett on July 15, 2014 [FEC:C00528182].

The Plaskett donation is structurally revealing. Stacey Plaskett was the USVI delegate to Congress — the representative with direct oversight jurisdiction over the territory where Epstein maintained his island compound, Southern Trust Company, and multiple corporate entities. Darren Indyke made an identical donation to the same committee, also listing NYSG as his employer [FEC:C00528182]. The use of New York Strategy Group as the common cover employer across FEC filings — an entity whose actual business operations remain opaque — and the targeting of a USVI delegate by multiple members of the inner circle are consistent with centrally directed political contributions in jurisdictions where Epstein’s operations were concentrated [Finding #450].

sections.title: The Travel and Property Network
sections.content:
Groff’s communications document the full geographic scope of Epstein’s operations. She coordinated travel across at least five jurisdictions: New York (9 East 71st Street, the East 69th Street properties), Paris (Avenue Foch apartments), the U.S. Virgin Islands (Great St. James and Red Hook), Morocco (La Mamounia hotel) [EFTA02270644], and Mongolia (the Advisory Board trip) [EFTA02714345]. Her role in managing property assignments is documented in communications tracking which apartments were available, directing guests to specific units, and ensuring preparations were complete before arrivals [EFTA02428343].

The April 2019 New York-to-Paris flight manifest she compiled reads as a roster of the inner circle in its final months of operation: Darren Indyke, Richard Kahn, Groff herself, household staff members Valdson, JoJo Fontanilla, Merwin Dela Cruz, and Bella Klein [EFTA02279594]. She coordinated with Maxim Churkin on Paris meetings and managed the logistics of an entourage that functioned as a self-contained traveling operation. Earlier, she had arranged tickets from St. Thomas to Miami [EFTA02268503], managed FlightAware tracking of N120JE (Epstein’s Gulfstream) [EFTA02232360], and booked commercial flights for those not traveling on the private aircraft.

The Mongolia connection merits attention. In January 2014, Groff received word from Lawrence Summers’s office that “Larry wants you to meet the President of Mongolia on Friday Jan 24th at 5:30” [EFTA02519011]. By July 2014, she was checking visa requirements for Epstein’s own travel to Mongolia, linking to the Mongolia Advisory Board that Enhanced Education funded [EFTA02714345]. She also managed wire instructions for the IJ Group through Bankwell bank and handled a 23andMe purchase for Sultan — likely Sultan bin Sulayem — at Epstein’s request in June 2017, with wire instructions routed through Bella Klein [EFTA02219317]. These tasks demonstrate that Groff’s operational role extended to managing financial transactions and international political access beyond calendar management.

sections.title: Legal Exposure and the Maxwell Connection
sections.content:
Groff appears in the documentary record connected to Ghislaine Maxwell through legal proceedings [DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402696], though the specific nature of this connection is underdeveloped in the current evidence base. She also coordinated communications with defense attorneys Michael F. Bachner and Martin Weinberg, indicating awareness of and involvement in the legal defense effort that surrounded the Epstein operation [Finding #343].

Her position as the person who managed travel bookings for young women, assigned apartment units, and ensured guests were received at Eurostar and other transit points placed her at the operational center of logistics that federal prosecutors later characterized as trafficking infrastructure. The documentary phrase “2G is clean and ready for next guest” [EFTA02428343] and the instruction to “make sure he is bringing Meghan” regarding General Clark’s visit [EFTA02428343] reflect a level of operational detail that extended beyond arm’s-length scheduling. She was named as one of four women who allegedly participated in recruiting and managing victims, alongside Maxwell, Sarah Kellen, and Adriana Ross.

Groff’s financial dependency on the network — the personal loans from Southern Financial LLC [EFTA02270094], the employment through DKIP LLC, the coordinated political giving [Finding #450] — created a web of obligations that would make cooperation with investigators personally costly. This dependency structure is consistent with patterns observed across Epstein’s inner circle, where financial entanglement served as a mechanism of control and ensured operational loyalty.

open_questions: What were the terms and amounts of Groff's multiple personal loans from Southern Financial LLC, and were they ever repaid or forgiven? Loan forgiveness would constitute taxable income and potentially an unreported benefit designed to secure loyalty.

Did Groff have signing authority on any Deutsche Bank accounts beyond The 2017 Caterpillar Trust? Her frequent co-appearance in the corpus with Amanda Kirby (83 documents) and Daniel Sabba (31 documents) suggests broader banking relationships than the single trust so far documented.

What was the full scope of Groff's involvement with Enhanced Education disbursements? She signed contracts on the entity's behalf, but her role in directing or approving the grants that flowed through the foundation remains undocumented.
What is the nature of Groff's connection to Ghislaine Maxwell in legal proceedings (DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402696)? Was she a witness, co-defendant, or referenced party in Maxwell-related litigation?

How did Groff's operational role change after mid-2017 when scheduling for some contacts (e.g., Vincenzo Iozzo) shifted to Bebe Avdiu at Indyke PLLC? Did she reduce involvement or shift to different functions within the network?
What was Groff's relationship to the New York Strategy Group beyond using it as her listed employer on FEC filings? NYSG's actual business operations remain almost entirely opaque.
